## Pack

<!-- Character or room pack, its id and a one-line description. Code changes are not accepted (see CONTRIBUTING.md). -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The pack is in `packs/characters/<id>/` or `packs/rooms/<id>/` and follows docs/packs.md
- [ ] `manifest.json` declares `CC0-1.0`, `CC-BY-4.0` or `MIT`, and `"original_work": true`
- [ ] It is my own original work and does not imitate existing game characters or brands
- [ ] Only PNG, JSON, Tiled and Markdown/text files, each at most 8 MiB, no symbolic links
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin)
